12 Entry Points

Prosecution

1. Crown Prosecution Service

CPS caseload 500K+ cases/year, charging decisions, case preparation, magistrates' court prosecution. Evidential test and public interest test application, victim and witness care, and Youth Court specialist prosecution.

Fraud

2. Serious Fraud Office

Complex fraud and bribery investigations, Deferred Prosecution Agreements, Section 2 powers, international mutual legal assistance. Corporate criminal liability, Bribery Act 2010 enforcement, and proceeds of crime recovery.

Legal

3. Government Legal Department

Legal advice to government departments, litigation conduct, parliamentary counsel drafting. GLD provides legal services across 25+ government departments with 2,000+ lawyers.

Advocacy

4. Treasury Devil & Government Advocacy

First Treasury Counsel, Government Legal Department advocates, Crown court and appellate advocacy. Treasury Devil opinion on sensitive government litigation, and Attorney General's reference on points of law.

Interest

5. Public Interest Litigation

Attorney General's fiat, relator proceedings, charities regulation, contempt of court. Public interest immunity certificates, closed material proceedings, and inquests with national security implications.

Oversight

6. Legal Oversight & Ethics

Law Officers' superintendence of CPS and SFO, referral of unduly lenient sentences, Attorney General's consent for prosecutions. Legal professional privilege, ethics advisory, and government lawyering standards.

International

7. International Legal Matters

International Court of Justice, International Criminal Court cooperation, mutual legal assistance treaties, extradition. Sovereign immunity, diplomatic immunity opinions, and treaty implementation.

National Security

8. National Security Law

Terrorism prosecution consent, state secrets, closed proceedings, special advocates. TPIMs, passport confiscation, citizenship deprivation legal oversight, and national security court management.

Charities

9. Charity Law & Regulation

Charity Commission oversight, charitable trust cy-près, charity dissolution, Attorney General's role in charity proceedings. Public benefit guidance, fundraising regulation, and trustee disqualification.

Data

10. Legal Data & Disclosure

Criminal Procedure & Investigations Act disclosure, unused material management, digital evidence handling. Body-worn video, digital forensic evidence, and sensitive material scheduling.

Inquests

11. Inquests & Public Inquiries

Coronial law oversight, Article 2 ECHR inquests, public inquiry legal framework. Hillsborough, Grenfell, Infected Blood inquiry legal coordination.

Accountability

12. Parliamentary Accountability

Attorney General's Questions, Law Officers' Convention, legal privilege in government. Written ministerial statements on legal matters, NAO legal spend audits, and Justice Committee oversight.

8 Transformation Priorities

Priority 1

CPS Charging Decision AI

Charging decision time 28d→7d, evidential test accuracy +35%. AI-assisted evidence review, case file quality assessment, and public interest test weighting. Target: 90% of straightforward charging decisions within 7 days.

Priority 2

SFO Investigation Intelligence

Case building time 3yr→18mo, financial flow tracing +60%. AI document review for Deferred Prosecution Agreement negotiations, cross-border asset tracing, and corporate structure analysis. Target: complex fraud investigation time reduced by 40%.

Priority 3

Government Legal AI Assistant

Legal advice turnaround 5d→2d, precedent identification accuracy +50%. AI-assisted legal research across government case law, statute, and treaty databases. Target: 80% of routine departmental legal queries answered within 48 hours.

Priority 4

Disclosure Automation

Unused material review time -70%, disclosure compliance rate >99%. AI-assisted sensitive material identification, relevance scoring, and PII scheduling. Target: zero disclosure failures in CPS prosecutions.

Priority 5

Unduly Lenient Sentence Detection

Referral identification 14d→48h, referral success rate +25%. AI monitoring of sentencing outcomes against guidelines, comparable cases, and victim impact. Target: comprehensive sentence monitoring for all indictable offences.

Priority 6

International Legal Intelligence

MLA processing time 12mo→3mo, treaty compliance monitoring 100%. AI-assisted mutual legal assistance request preparation, extradition case management, and international court preparation. Target: real-time treaty compliance dashboard.

Priority 7

Charity Regulatory AI

Compliance monitoring coverage 30%→80%, fraud detection +45%. AI financial analysis of charity accounts, public benefit assessment, and fundraising regulation monitoring. Target: 100% of large charities under continuous AI-assisted monitoring.

Priority 8

Public Inquiry Document Processing

Document review throughput 10K→100K pages/day, relevance classification >90%. AI-assisted disclosure review for public inquiries, witness statement analysis, and timeline reconstruction. Target: evidence processing bottleneck eliminated for major inquiries.

⛔ 6 Sovereign Red Lines

  • 🚫 No charging decision made by automated system — CPS prosecutor must apply evidential and public interest tests personally.
  • 🚫 No Deferred Prosecution Agreement terms negotiated by AI — SFO Director explicit approval required for all corporate resolutions.
  • 🚫 No government legal advice generated without qualified government lawyer review and sign-off.
  • 🚫 No public interest immunity certificate issued by automated system — Treasury Counsel or Law Officer authorisation required.
  • 🚫 No unduly lenient sentence referral initiated without Attorney General personal consent.
  • 🚫 No state secrets or sensitive material classified or declassified by AI — security-cleared human decision required.

5-Step Engagement Model

1
Discovery
Map AGO estate — CPS (14 areas), SFO, GLD (25+ departments), Treasury Devil, charity regulation. Identify AI-ready processes and sovereignty constraints across prosecution, legal advice, and oversight pillars.
2
Governance Design
Deploy DORADO patterns — legal professional privilege gates, prosecution independence safeguards, national security classification controls. Align with Article 50, Prosecution of Offences Act, and Criminal Procedure & Investigations Act.
3
Pilot
Launch controlled pilots in CPS charging decision support, disclosure review automation, and government legal research. Measure against KPIs: charging decision time, disclosure compliance, legal advice turnaround.
4
Scale
Roll out proven MCPs across CPS, SFO, and GLD. Integrate with case management systems, court digital infrastructure, and government legal portals. Deploy sovereign OWEM adapters for legal domain specialisation.
5
Assure
Continuous sovereignty verification — prosecution independence, legal privilege protection, parliamentary accountability. Attorney General reporting, Justice Committee oversight, and Law Officers' Convention compliance.
